mapper.update: UPDATE UB_MEMBER um SET um.member_state = '계정 삭제' WHERE um.member_number = #{memberNumber} AND um.member_type IN ('MENTOR', 'MENTEE', 'NODECIDED') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM UB_MATCHING m WHERE m.matching_state = '매칭중' AND ( (um.member_type = 'MENTOR' AND um.member_number = m.mentor_number) OR (um.member_type = 'MENTEE' AND um.member_number = m.mentee_number) ) )
mapper.select: SELECT t.*, usj.subject_name AS `subject_name`, uf.FILE_ORIGINAL_NAME AS `file_name` FROM ( SELECT um.member_number AS `member_number`, um.member_id AS `member_id`, um.member_name AS `member_name`, um.member_nickname AS `member_nickname`, um.member_gender AS `member_gender`, um.member_phone AS `member_phone`, um.member_type AS `member_type`, um.member_state AS `member_state`, usmtr.grad_school AS `mtr_grad_school`, usmtr.grad_depart AS `mtr_grad_depart`, usmtr.grad_score AS `mtr_grad_score`, usmte.mentee_school AS `mte_school`, usmte.mentee_grade AS `mte_grade`, usmte.mentee_hopeuni AS `mte_hope_uni`, usmte.mentee_hopemajor AS `mte_hope_major`, us.SURVEY_TYPE AS `survey_type`, us.FILE_NUMBER AS `file_number`, IFNULL(usmtr.subject_number, usmte.subject_number) AS `subject_number` FROM UB_MEMBER um LEFT OUTER JOIN UB_SURVEY_MENTEE usmte ON um.survey_number = usmte.survey_number LEFT OUTER JOIN UB_SURVEY_MENTOR usmtr ON um.survey_number = usmtr.survey_number LEFT OUTER JOIN UB_SURVEY us ON um.survey_number = us.SURVEY_NUMBER AND us.SURVEY_APPROVAL = 'P' ) t LEFT OUTER JOIN UB_SUBJECT usj ON t.subject_number = usj.subject_number AND usj.subject_status = '활성' LEFT OUTER JOIN UB_FILE uf ON t.file_number = uf.FILE_NUMBER WHERE t.member_Number = #{memberNumber}
